user.title: Swiss Solar Reference Price (SFOE)
user.description: Sets up the sensor for the quarterly solar reference market price published by the Swiss Federal Office of Energy (Art. 15 EnFV), plus a feed-in price computed from it.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one instance of this integration can be configured.

unreachable.title: Swiss Solar Reference Price: service unreachable
unreachable.description: The service at {host} has not answered for several refreshes in a row. Check your internet connection; if it is fine, the service itself is down. The entities stay unavailable until then and recover on their own; this notice disappears with the next successful refresh.

unreadable.title: Swiss Solar Reference Price: data file unreadable
unreadable.description: The SFOE file at {host} was downloaded but could not be read for several refreshes in a row; its format has probably changed. The price sensors stay unavailable until the integration is updated. Please report it on the integration's issue tracker.
